facts.fact: The Central Bank of Somalia says it mandated NIRA ID for opening and updating bank accounts from 1 September 2025 and that all banks are integrated to the NIRA platform.
NIRA says banks (KYC), telecoms (mandatory SIM registration), the Civil Service Commission (payroll identity verification) and the education ministry use the national ID for verification.
The Central Bank of Somalia says about 20 thousand verifications were made since September 2025, and NIRA says 100+ services are integrated.
